description: Defines data structures, functions, and mechanisms for thread-local counters and global counter aggregation in the trace2 system.

methods.name: tr2_counter_increment
methods.description: Increments a specific counter for the current thread.

methods.name: tr2_update_final_counters
methods.description: Adds the current thread's counter data to the global totals during thread exit.

methods.name: tr2_emit_per_thread_counters
methods.description: Emits counter data for the current thread during thread exit.

methods.name: tr2_emit_final_counters
methods.description: Emits the final global counter values during program exit.
